title: Define custom starting positions and position editor
source: The owner requested custom starting positions during the move-contract discussion in the child thread.
pendingQuestion: Should imported FEN move numbers and fifty-move-rule counters be preserved, with repetition counting starting only at the new game start?
recommendation: Preserve the FEN counters and count repetitions from the new game start.
acceptedScope: The MVP includes human-selected starting positions for play against a model opponent. Chess.com and Lichess are familiar examples, without a decision to copy their full feature sets.
terminalSummary: New custom-position games start with fresh instructions, FEN, and piece list. Draw counters and repetition history remain undecided.
acceptedInputMethods: Visual board editor for arranging pieces.
FEN import by pasting a position string.

acceptedValidation.startPlay: Require basic chess-validity checks to pass.
acceptedValidation.modelGuidance: Setup validation does not supply legal moves or strategy to the model.
acceptedValidation.remaining: Exact validation checks and actionable error messages.

acceptedPositionSettings.consistency: The editor settings must agree with the position used for play and supplied to the model.

acceptedCustomStartResults.label: Custom position
acceptedCustomStartResults.practiceException: Post-loss continuation remains unscored under the move-contract decision.

acceptedExistingGameEditing.originalGame: Preserve it and any recorded result.
acceptedExistingGameEditing.newGameResult: Use the accepted Custom position result policy.
acceptedExistingGameEditing.initialContext: Use the accepted fresh starting context for the separate custom-position game.

acceptedStartingContext.sourceGameConversation: Leave it with the original game.
acceptedStartingContext.ordinaryModelSwitch: Carry the current game full prior conversation under the existing model-switch decision.
